title: Louis Armstrong Jeepers Creepers CD, Newsound 2000 - Jazz
descriptionText: The product is a CD by jazz artist Louis Armstrong, titled "Jeepers Creepers," released in 2000 under the record label Newsound 2000. This CD features classic jazz songs by Louis Armstrong in a high-quality format, making it a must-have for jazz enthusiasts looking to enjoy his timeless music. With its smooth melodies and iconic vocals, this CD is sure to be a standout addition to any music collection.
